scope: Generator code and unit tests on synthetic fixtures. dataset/real is not on this machine, so no copy-paste dataset was generated from the 46 approved photographs and no training was started.

design.sources: bank JSON built from the current approved review snapshot (same pointer, hash and validate_review checks as prepare_real_training); approved instances become cutouts, approved empty-tray photos become backgrounds
design.leakage_guard: bank split must be train; instances/backgrounds in held_out_groups are refused; bank build can exclude validation/test leakage groups
design.labels: exported from the pasted approved mask with prepare_real_training.mask_polygon (one component, no holes, round-trip IoU >= 0.995)
design.placement: non-overlapping with min gap, fully inside optional tray ROI polygon, relative object size kept from the source photo with jitter
design.augmentation: horizontal flip, rotation <= 10 deg, gain 0.9-1.1, edge feathering, one soft shadow direction per scene; label stays the hard mask
design.sampling: inverse class frequency so rare real classes are pasted about as often as common ones
design.outputs: images/train, labels/train, manifest.jsonl with per-instance provenance, freeze.json with hashes; refuses nonempty output; verify re-hashes; final_test_eligible=false everywhere
design.config: vision/configs/real_copy_paste_v1.json holds starting values only; to be chosen on independent real validation (D-07), never on test data

mutation_checks.no_heldout_instance_check: detected (after adding separate instance/background cases; first run survived because the background check also fired)

visual_check: Default config on fixtures: label contours coincide with pasted objects, shadows faint, no overlaps, one empty scene; preview kept in session scratchpad only (fixtures, not real data)
not_done: Generate from dataset/real approved snapshot (needs data migration or running on the original machine)
Visual spot check of real pasted scenes (seams, scale, shadow realism)
Effect on a model: requires independent real validation sessions (D-05/D-07) and the D-36 runner
